e\n                        );\n                    }\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            if line.trim().is_empty() {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            match JsonlParser::parse_line(&line, line_num, &context, plugin) {\n                Ok(mut line_events) => events.append(&mut line_events),\n                Err(e) => {\n                    if e.is_skippable() {\n                        // Log at warn level instead of eprintln to respect tracing filters\n                        warn!(\"{}\", e);\n                    } else {\n                        return Err(e);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>> {\n        // For JSONL with one-file-per-session, the file itself is the session\n        match &plugin.source.session_detection {\n            SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => {\n                let session_id = match session_id_from {\n                    SessionIdSource::Filename => {\n                        // For subagent sessions, include parent directory in session ID\n                        // to maintain hierarchy and avoid collisions\n                        if is_subagent_file(source_path) {\n                            // Extract path from \".../<parent>/subagents/<agent>.jsonl\"\n                            // to get \"<parent>/<agent>\"\n                            derive_subagent_ids(source_path)\n                                .map(|(session_id, _parent)| session_id)\n                                .unwrap_or_else(|| {\n                                    source_path\n                                        .file_stem()\n                                        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                        .to_string()\n                                })\n                        } else {\n                            source_path\n                                .file_stem()\n                                .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                                .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                                .to_string()\n                        }\n                    }\n                    SessionIdSource::Field(field) => {\n                        // Read first line to extract session ID (handle zst)\n                        match open_file_maybe_zst(source_path) {\n                            Ok(mut reader) => {\n                                let mut first_line = String::new();\n                                if reader.read_line(&mut first_line).is_ok() {\n                                    if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&first_line) {\n                                        // Envelope-aware session ID extraction\n                                        // Check if we have envelope config\n                                        let (envelope_json, payload_json) = if let Some(\n                                            ref envelope_cfg,\n                                        ) =\n                                            plugin.source.envelope\n                                        {\n                                            let type_value = extract_string_with_envelope(\n                                                &envelope_cfg.type_field,\n                                                &json,\n                                                Some(&json),\n                                            )\n                                            .unwrap_or_default();\n                                            let routing = envelope_cfg.get_routing(&type_value);\n\n                                            // Only extract if this line has routing\n                                            if routing == \"event\" || routing == \"meta\" {\n                                                let extracted = json\n                                                    .get(&envelope_cfg.payload_field)\n                                                    .and_then(|v| match v {\n                                                        Value::Object(_) => Some(v),\n                                                        _ => None,\n                                                    });\n                                                match extracted {\n                                                    Some(payload) => (Some(&json), payload),\n                                                    None => (None, &json),\n                                                }\n                                            } else {\n                                                (None, &json)\n                                            }\n                                        } else {\n                                            (None, &json)\n                                        };\n\n                                        extract_string_with_envelope(\n                                            field,\n                                            payload_json,\n                                            envelope_json,\n                                        )\n                                        .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string())\n                                    } else {\n                                        \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                    }\n                                } else {\n                                    \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                }\n                            }\n                            Err(_) => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n                        }\n                    }\n                };\n\n                let file_size = std::fs::metadata(source_path)?.len();\n\n                // Detect subagent sessions and extract parent_session_id from directory structure\n                //\n                // Subagent files are at: .../<parent-session-uuid>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl\n                //\n                // ROOT CAUSE FIX (bead bf-1pkfp):\n                // The previous implementation required:\n                // 1. At least 2 components before \"subagents\" (subagents_idx >= 2)\n                // 2. A \"projects\" directory somewhere before the parent session\n                //\n                // This caused test fixtures and non-standard directory structures to fail\n                // parent_session_id extraction because they didn't match the exact production\n                // layout of ~/.claude/projects/<path>/<parent>/subagents/...\n                //\n                // THE FIX:\n                // - Removed the \"projects\" directory requirement entirely\n                // - Reduced minimum components before \"subagents\" from 2 to 1\n                // - Directly extract parent session ID as the component immediately before \"subagents\"\n                //\n                // This allows subagent detection to work for both:\n                // - Production paths: ~/.claude/projects/<path>/<parent>/subagents/...\n                // - Test paths: /tmp/.../sessions/<parent>/subagents/...\n                //\n                let parent_session_id = source_path\n                    .components()\n                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                    .iter()\n                    .position(|c| c.as_os_str() == \"subagents\")\n                    .and_then(|subagents_idx| {\n                        // Parent session UUID is the component before \"subagents\"\n                        // We need at least 1 component before \"subagents\": .../<parent-session>/subagents/...\n                        if subagents_idx >= 1 {\n                            let components: Vec<_> = source_path.components().collect();\n\n                            // The parent session is the component immediately before \"subagents\"\n                            let parent_idx = subagents_idx - 1;\n\n                            components\n                                .get(parent_idx)\n                                .and_then(|c| c.as_os_str().to_str())\n                                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n                        } else {\n                            None\n                        }\n                    });\n\n                Ok(vec![SessionInfo {\n                    session_id,\n                    start_offset: 0,\n                    end_offset: file_size,\n                    metadata: None,\n                    parent_session_id,\n                }])\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // For other detection methods, we'd need to parse the whole file\n                // For Phase 1, we only support one-file-per-session for JSONL\n                Ok(vec![])\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::parser::FormatParser;\n    use crate::plugin::{\n        LogFormat, Parser, Plugin, PluginMeta, SessionDetection, SessionIdSource, Format parsers for agent logs and utility parsers\n//!\n//! This module provides two categories of parsers:\n//!\n//! ## Format Parsers (Agent Log Normalization)\n//!\n//! These parsers normalize raw agent logs into the canonical event schema.\n//! Each parser handles one log format:\n//!\n//! - **[`JsonlParser`]**: JSONL format (Claude Code, Codex, Goose)\n//! - **[`MarkdownParser`]**: Markdown format (Aider)\n//! - **[`JsonTreeParser`]**: JSON tree format (OpenCode legacy)\n//! - **[`JsonArrayParser`]**: JSON array format (Gemini CLI)\n//! - **[`SqliteParser`]**: SQLite format (Cursor, Windsurf)\n//!\n//! Format parsers are used internally by the scraper plugin system. Each plugin\n//! specifies its format in the `[source] format` field, and the corresponding\n//! parser is instantiated to normalize events.\n//!\n//! All format parsers:\n//! - Read source files in streaming fashion\n//! - Extract timestamps, roles, content, and metadata\n//! - Normalize to the canonical [`Event`] schema\n//! - Handle errors gracefully (skip bad lines, log warnings)\n//!\n//! ## Utility Parsers\n//!\n//! - **[`ImportParser`]**: Extracts Rust import statements from source files\n//!   (use, extern crate, mod statements). Used for code analysis and rule generation.\n//!\n//! # Common Functionality\n//!\n//! All parsers in this module share:\n//! - Field extraction utilities with dot notation support\n//! - Timestamp parsing from ISO 8601, Unix epoch, and custom formats\n//! - Envelope-aware extraction session\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\n#[allow(dead_code)]\npub struct ParseContext {\n    pub session_id: String,\n    pub source_agent: String,\n    pub source_file: String,\n    pub project: Option<String>,\n    pub model: Option<String>,\n    pub line_number: usize,\n}\n\nimpl ParseContext {\n    pub fn new(session_id: String, source_agent: String, source_file: String) -> Self {\n        ParseContext {\n            session_id,\n            source_agent,\n            source_file,\n            project: None,\n            model: None,\n            line_number: 0,\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    pub fn with_project(mut self, project: Option<String>) -> Self {\n        self.project = project;\n        self\n    }\n\n    #[allow(dead_code)]\n    pub fn with_model(mut }\n}\n\n/// Check if a field name has a caret prefix (^)\n///\n/// Returns true if the field name starts with `^`, false otherwise.\n/// Handles empty strings gracefully (returns false).\n///\n/// # Examples\n/// ```\n/// use agentscribe::parser::has_caret_prefix;\n///\n/// assert!(has_caret_prefix(\"^foo\"));\n/// assert!(!has_caret_prefix(\"foo\"));\n/// assert!(!has_caret_prefix(\"bar^baz\"));\n/// assert!(!has_caret_prefix(\"\"));\n/// ```\npub fn has_caret_prefix(field_name: &str) -> bool {\n    field_name.starts_with('^')\n}\n\n/// Extract a nested field from JSON using dot notation\npub fn extract_field(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Option<Value> {\n    if path.is_empty() {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    let mut current = value;\n    for part in path.split('.') {\n        // Handle array indexing like parts[0]\n        if let Some(bracket_pos) = part.find('[') {\n            let key = &part[..bracket_pos];\n            let index_str = &part[bracket_pos + 1..part.len() - 1];\n            let index: usize = index_str.parse().ok()?;\n\n            current = current.get(key)?.get(index)?;\n        } else {\n            current = current.get(part)?;\n        }\n    }\n    Some(current.clone())\n}\n\n/// Extract a string field from JSON\npub fn extract_string(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Option<String> {\n    let field = extract_field(value, path)?;\n    match field {\n        Value::String(s) => Some(s),\n        Value::Number(n) => Some(n.to_string()),\n        Value::Bool(b) => Some(b.to_string()),\n        Value::Null => Some(String::new()),\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Parse timestamp from various formats\npub fn parse_timestamp(value: &Value, path: &str) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n    let ts_str = extract_string(value, path)\n        .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n\n    // Try ISO 8601 first\n    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n        return Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing as Unix epoch (seconds)\n    if let Ok(seconds) = ts_str.parse::<i64>() {\n        let ts = if seconds > 1_000_000_000_000 {\n            // Milliseconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(seconds)\n        } else {\n            // Seconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n        };\n        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n        return Ok(dt);\n    }\n\n    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n        ts_str\n    )))\n}\n\n/// Extract a field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n///\n/// **Envelope-first with payload fallback for caret-prefixed paths:**\n/// - If path starts with `^`, try envelope first (remove `^` prefix)\n/// - If envelope is None OR field not found in envelope, fallback to payload\n/// - Otherwise, extract from payload only\n///\n/// **Resolution order for `^field`:**\n/// 1. Try `envelope.field` (if envelope exists)\n/// 2. Fallback to `payload.field` (if envelope missing or field not found)\n/// 3. Return None (if both fail)\n///\n/// **Resolution order for `field` (no caret):**\n/// - Extract from `payload.field` only\n///\n/// Supports dot notation for nested fields (e.g., `^outer.ts` or `user.role`)\n/// and array indexing (e.g., `items[0].name`).\npub fn extract_with_envelope(\n    path: &str,\n    payload: &Value,\n    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n) -> Option<Value> {\n    if has_caret_prefix(path) {\n        // Strip the caret prefix\n        if let Some(envelope_path) = path.strip_prefix('^') {\n            // Try envelope first\n            if let Some(env) = envelope {\n                if let Some(value) = extract_field(env, envelope_path) {\n                    return Some(value); // Found in envelope\n                }\n            }\n            // Fallback to payload (using path without ^)\n            extract_field(payload, envelope_path)\n        } else {\n            // Should not happen due to starts_with check, but handle defensively\n            None\n        }\n    } else {\n        // No caret prefix - extract from payload only\n        extract_field(payload, path)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Extract a string field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n///\n/// Wrapper around `extract_with_envelope` that converts the raw `Value` to a string,\n/// following the same coercion rules as `extract_string` (String, Number, Bool, Null).\npub fn extract_string_with_envelope(\n    path: &str,\n    payload: &Value,\n    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n) -> Option<String> {\n    let value = extract_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)?;\n    match value {\n        Value::String(s) => Some(s),\n        Value::Number(n) => Some(n.to_string()),\n        Value::Bool(b) => Some(b.to_string()),\n        Value::Null => Some(String::new()),\n        Value::Array(arr) => {\n            // Handle content arrays (e.g., Claude Code format with text blocks and tool calls)\n            // Extract text from all text blocks in the array\n            let text_parts: Vec<String> = arr\n                .iter()\n                .filter_map(|item| {\n                    if let Some(obj) = item.as_object() {\n                        // Check for text blocks: {\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"...\"}\n                        if obj.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some(\"text\") {\n                            return obj\n                                .get(\"text\")\n                                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n                                .map(|s| s.to_string());\n                        }\n                    }\n                    None\n                })\n                .collect();\n            if text_parts.is_empty() {\n                None\n            } else {\n                Some(text_parts.join(\" \"))\n            }\n        }\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Parse a timestamp from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n///\n/// Wrapper around `extract_string_with_envelope` that parses the extracted string\n/// as a timestamp. Supports ISO 8601, Unix epoch (seconds/milliseconds), and\n/// UTC-naive formats.\npub fn parse_timestamp_with_envelope(\n    path: &str,\n    payload: &Value,\n    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n    let ts_str = extract_string_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)\n        .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n\n    // Try ISO 8601 first\n    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n        return Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing as Unix epoch (seconds)\n    if let Ok(seconds) = ts_str.parse::<i64>() {\n        let ts = if seconds > 1_000_000_000_000 {\n            // Milliseconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(seconds)\n        } else {\n            // Seconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n        };\n        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n        return Ok(dt);\n    }\n\n    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n        ts_str\n    )))\n}\n\n/// Base trait for all format parsers\npub trait FormatParser {\n    /// Parse events from the source\n    fn parse(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<Event>>;\n\n    /// Parse events from the source, starting from a given byte offset for incremental parsing.\n    ///\n    /// For formats that support incremental parsing (JSONL, append-only logs), this allows\n    /// the parser to skip already-processed content and only parse new data.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// * `source_path` - Path to the source file\n    /// * `plugin` - Plugin configuration for this source\n    /// * `start_offset` - Byte offset to start reading from (0 for full parse)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// - `Ok(events)` - Vector of parsed events\n    /// - `Err(_)` - Parse error (check `is_skippable()` for non-fatal errors)\n    fn parse_incremental(\n        &self,\n        source_path: &Path,\n        plugin: &Plugin,\n        start_offset: u64,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        // Default implementation falls back to full parse\n        let _ = start_offset; // Suppress unused warning\n        self.parse(source_path, plugin)\n    }\n\n    /// Detect session boundaries in the source\n    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>>;\n}\n\n/// Information about a detected session\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\n#[allow(dead_code)]\npub struct SessionInfo {\n    pub session_id: String,\n    pub start_offset: u64,\n    pub end_offset: u64,\n    pub metadata: Option<Value>,\n    /// Parent session ID (populated for subagent sessions where this session\n    /// is a child of another session)\n    pub parent_session_id: Option<String>,\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use serde_json::json;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_extract_field_simple() {\n        let value = json!({\"name\": \"test\",
